answer_1.quote: Through this interactive mechanism, DiagNote can achieve more effective reasoning with multimodal information, resulting in accurate and context-aware responses throughout dialogues... The model performs multi-step interactions between Deliberate and Gaze at each turn to generate the answer ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language answers, reasoning chains (CoT), and grounding annotations (bounding boxes).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate DiagNote on standard grounding (GND) benchmarks ... using average IoU scores ... We also evaluate using "ad-hoc" reasoning-based scoring across five categories on a 0-10 scale.

answer_3.quote: To mitigate evaluation bias, our primary evaluator is Gemini-1.5-Pro, as GPT-4o-mini was part of our data generation pipeline. We also performed the evaluation using GPT-4o, and the results showed high consistency.
methods: LLM-based scoring prompt (0-10 scale across multiple criteria)

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 150 dialogues (50 from each scene) and the authors then annotated each dialogue based on four key dimensions: Fluency, Coherence, Correctness & Relevance, and Complexity, using a 5-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each dialogue on Fluency, Coherence, Correctness & Relevance, and Complexity on a 1‑5 Likert scale.
